refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: metrics-exporter is a systemd1 socket-activated service which collects additional system metrics and provides them via a varlink interface to systemd-report1.

Currently, metrics-exporter provides metrics about the SELinux status of the system, such as whether SELinux is enabled, the running and configured mode, the loaded policy and its version, and the state of the SELinux policy booleans. It also provides metrics about the network configuration, such as the configured IP addresses, the state of the network devices and the number of interfaces managed by NetworkManager.
metrics-exporter@.service is started on demand by metrics-exporter.socket whenever a client connects to the Varlink socket. It is not meant to be started or enabled manually.

refsect1.title: Varlink Interface
refsect1.para: metrics-exporter implements the io.systemd.Metrics Varlink interface, the same interface systemd1 itself uses to export its own metrics. It is reachable through the socket /run/systemd/report/org.openSUSE.Metrics, which is created by metrics-exporter.socket.

listitem.para: Returns the current value of every metric provided by metrics-exporter.
Returns the name, description and type (counter, gauge, string or object) of every metric family provided by metrics-exporter.

refsect1.para: All metric names use the org.openSUSE.Metrics prefix.

refsect1.title: Metrics
refsect1.para: The following metric families are currently provided:

listitem.para: Version of the running metrics-exporter.

Per interface metric reporting a configured IP address in CIDR notation. Every address of an interface is reported as a separate metric object, with family (ipv4 or ipv6) and scope (global, link or site) fields. Loopback addresses are not reported.

Per interface metric reporting the state of a network device as seen by NetworkManager (for example Activated (Connected), Disconnected or Unmanaged), together with the corresponding numeric NetworkManager device state in the state field. Interfaces not known to NetworkManager are reported as Unmanaged. This metric is only available if metrics-exporter was built with NetworkManager support.
The number of network interfaces currently managed by NetworkManager. This metric is only available if metrics-exporter was built with NetworkManager support.
Whether SELinux is enabled or disabled.
The currently running SELinux mode, permissive or enforcing.
The SELinux mode configured in /etc/selinux/config.
The SELinux root directory.
The name of the loaded SELinux policy.
Whether the loaded policy has MLS support enabled or disabled.
Whether unknown permissions are allowed or denied by the loaded policy.
The memory protection checking mode enforced by the kernel.
The maximum SELinux policy version supported by the running kernel.
Name, version, release and architecture of the installed selinux-policy package.
The current state (on or off) of every SELinux policy boolean, one metric object per boolean. If the pending value of a boolean differs from its active value, an additional pending field is reported.

refsect1.para: The SELinux metrics are only reported if SELinux support was compiled into metrics-exporter and can be disabled or restricted via metrics-exporter.conf5.

The network metrics can be disabled entirely via metrics-exporter.conf5. The org.openSUSE.Metrics.Network.DeviceState and org.openSUSE.Metrics.Network.ManagedInterfaces metrics are only reported if metrics-exporter was built with NetworkManager support.

refsect1.title: Configuration
refsect1.para: metrics-exporter reads its configuration from metrics-exporter.conf. See metrics-exporter.conf5 for a description of the file format and the recognized options.
